title: 6. Sovereignty: doing what the human is good at

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: SRS is about human and AI collaboration. The owner keeps sovereignty by judging what they can review, not by clicking through what they cannot.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: The owner, 2026-10-30: "SRS is about human-si collaboration. I maintain sovereignty by doing the things I'm good at.. not being a click monkey affirming things I can't review." The same point in earlier words: a yes given in chat without seeing the structure is a fake decision (81f2bf49), and "A tick or a deny, right where I write" (67459d40). Sovereignty therefore sits with the owner's narrative (the vignettes), the decisions only the owner can take, and the tip they choose to manage. Agents carry the volume: clustering, linking, deriving, and the confidence that follows from cross-checks.

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: What does the owner review, and in what form, so that review is judgement rather than clicking: a story, a diff of what changed, the low-confidence items only?
